scope: 4 original registered readers; additional original read/traverse/business exceptions; contribution to main30-app audit only

definitions.NO: Prove earlier sibling output/state writes cannot affect later graph/payload/visit/queue/write accesses under stated closed-world contracts.
definitions.MAY: Statically expose a feasible data/control/queue effect witness; this is a decidable conservative finding, not an impossibility result.
definitions.UNKNOWN: Insufficient effects/alias/graph facts for this bounded audit; current analyzer unsupported is separate.
definitions.simplification: Optional semantics-preserving output slicing/inlining/phase separation, or equivalent hypothetical compiler/effect-summary feature; not an implemented pass.

assumptions: Ordinary Jac node/walker fields and view objects; fixed loaded graph during each read request; no monkeypatch/custom descriptor effects.
jid is identity-only; native graph-query/visit/report and ordinary containers have declared effects. ACL/root lookup is stable read-only context during the read.
Native eager visit evaluates/demands its endpoint batch before later ability entries; cancellation of entries is different from retroactively undemanding those endpoints.
Node names LinkedList/FolderTree do not impose cardinality, unique parent or acyclicity constraints.

registered_readers.witness: After a common prefix of9998 entries, queued B and C share visited. B increments to9999 and enqueues its child; C increments to10000 and cancels the walk, suppressing further queued access. A sibling changes the remaining visit/cancellation budget.
registered_readers.simplification: Can expose/encode bounded total-visit budget, but cannot soundly turn this into depth without a single-successor/cardinality and acyclicity/queue proof.
registered_readers.fixture_scope: Generator build.py:63-70 constructs an acyclic single Next chain. That separate fixture proof makes sibling frontier vacuous for the chain; smoke32/small1000 also below cutoff. Source schema alone has no such constraint.

registered_readers.reason: run and collect issue fixed relative paths. Tweet.to_view reads root->Profile and ordinary Tweet fields; neither helper nor abilities mutate graph or read feed/search-result state to choose any graph access. search_query is immutable input and applies only after views are built.
registered_readers.simplification: Summarize Tweet.to_view as read-only root/Profile path + pure view construction, then separate feed accumulation/sort from access control. Could be an analyzer feature instead of a source rewrite.

registered_readers.reason: _message_view reads AuthoredBy/reply-count and plain fields; _resolve_author local loop returns a username. Message siblings do not share mutable access-control state; incoming ReplyTo visit is unconditional. Recursive reply graph may branch/cycle; independence alone proves neither chain cardinality nor termination.
registered_readers.simplification: Inline/summarize _message_view and _resolve_author; report construction has no graph/queue writes.

registered_readers.proof_kind: backward access slice separates shared path/depth/output from visits
registered_readers.reason: depths/paths are genuinely read after other nodes write them; shared/reconvergent child IDs can change OUTPUT path/depth. Those values never choose the two graph reads or final visit. Both use here->Contains->Folder with immutable node-field predicate trashed==False. start_id only initializes output context and selects final report.
registered_readers.simplification: Slice away output-only map propagation/append/sort while retaining graph-read effects; no need assume distinct map keys to prove FUTURE ACCESS independence. No seen-set in this walker.

additional_walkers.reason: total is written at entry and read only for exit reports; unconditional Next visit never reads total.
found itself is output-only (never read), but a target match calls disengage before Next visit. Queued matching B suppresses later C ability/path access; explicit queue cancellation effect.

seen_profiles membership returns before Post visit (309-314); root_profile_id written by first Profile suppresses Follow visits in later Profiles (315-317). seen_tweets suppresses to_view root/Profile read for repeated Tweet (321-327). Distinct output feed is not the cause.
seen[cid] gates Channel.to_view(False). A repeated Channel sibling skips root/Profile, membership and member-count graph reads. No further visit is needed for real future-access dependence.

seen return gates ordinary content/string tally only; no graph query, visit, graph write or disengage follows it. counts and seen affect output, unlike get_channels. allroots enumeration is a read-only builtin contract.
to_user_view pure; to_profile_view graph reads depend on current Profile and immutable with-context, not results accumulator.

jobj(input_id) then visit[target] has at most one target; resolved actor is fixed context for that target, not sibling feedback. Derived walkers write likes/comments/edges/delete nodes and often disengage: retain graph-write/cancel effects, never summarize as read-only. Their changes affect later requests; this is not evidence of two sibling entries in the singleton native invocation. _now/grant/jobj require builtin/external summaries.

ids length reaches limit inside first workspace channels loop; return suppresses HasChannel graph query of later workspace. This is iteration dependence, not two queued abilities. Prefix/order/cardinality summary needed for faithful batching.
local out appends never influence later graph access; guards use invariant input/current resolved object.

Single Root entry, no queued child abilities. Graph writes/permission grants can affect later requests. JoinWorkspace loop read/return uses DB membership, not a mutated per-sibling accumulator. Clock/grant/jobj need effect contracts; no blanket sibling proof for arbitrary external implementations.
_folder_view reads Folder/File children. Local entries and each child trashed branch control output constructors only, with no shared-state-gated subsequent graph read.

Create/attach and trashed writes affect later tree/list requests. Native endpoints invoke one Root/Folder, not sibling recursion. Do not erase DB writes or confuse cross-request dependencies with read-walker sibling dependence.

Ambient storage.upload/get_metadata/exists/download and file object methods are external. Need effect/alias contracts; no theoretical impossibility claimed. Native.py replay does not invoke these walkers.

provenance: Read-only inspection; no imports of Jac runtime/compiler, no tests/DB/benchmark execution; hashes are source bytes, not native acceptance.
